roleTitle: I build systems where documents, rules, people, and deadlines all connect.
paragraphs: I'm Pujan Bajracharya, a legal workflow and AI systems builder with experience across full-stack engineering, product design, AI orchestration, and litigation operations.
My work focuses on making complex workflows easier to understand, verify, and act on.

highlights.title: Workflow Logic
highlights.desc: I model processes as states, signals, tasks, deadlines, and review points.

highlights.title: Document Intelligence
highlights.desc: I work with OCR, classification, metadata extraction, and review queues.

highlights.title: AI With Review
highlights.desc: I design RAG, eval, and human-in-the-loop systems instead of blind automation.

highlights.title: Product Engineering
highlights.desc: I build usable tools with UX, frontend systems, backend logic, and domain research.

callout: The goal is simple: make complex workflows structured, reviewable, and useful.
